//: Requirement ids held for unlanded branches, so that two branches never
write the same new id. A branch reserves its range here in a docs-only
landing under the lock before it writes the ids, and releases it --
deletes or shrinks its entry -- in the commit that writes them, so the
release lands with the ids. tools/common/check/check-traceability.py
refuses a new id that main's copy of this file did not hold at the
branch's merge-base, and a range that overlaps another or holds an id
the model defines. `ids` takes single ids and ranges, L.object.106-112.
docs/CONVENTIONS.md, 'Requirement ids are reserved before they are written'.

reservations.purpose: Stage 13 cgroup control: the cgctl landing chain (allocated by os-ad via os-79)

NVIDIA N0g (docs/NVIDIA.md §12.3, the consultant's OK IF C1): interrupt remapping (L.iommu.47, 48 and 51 written by slice 1, which released L.iommu.49 to F-58's L.iommu.56/57) on VT-d, remappable MSI and I/O APIC messages, x2APIC left on, interrupt faults, the isolated-interrupts mark; a device raises only the vectors minted for it

NVIDIA C3-K, the kernel's fault windows (docs/NVIDIA.md §11.4, the consultant's OK IF of 2026-10-02): window regions, forwarded faults and their wait, kernel copies that never wait, refused partial operations, the mapping count and UNMAPPED, break-before-make entries, revoke, server death, insert checks and holds, answers only from the server handle; a server-inserted frame unreachable before its hold goes, and a client waiting on a server only by its own mapping

OPAQUE-KERNEL.md §9.8 steps 2b and 2a (the consultant's OK IF of 2026-10-02): the preemption count without a locked operation, FX-0503 at the switch and at an unmatched enable, may_block, try_lock and try_lock_manually leaving the count as found; the running task by borrow, and current() without the run queue's lock

OPAQUE-KERNEL s9.8 steps 2d and 2c (session B, the consultant's OK and OK IF of 2026-10-02): the SYSCALL entry's one decode with the native range first; the pending-work word, sched::notify and post_own, the way out's masked look, the core's own END at termination, the check-mode attention audit, the wake row and its stage-9 hook; one row per bit, TRACE and FILTERED reserved
